originalTitle: Govt of Singapore’s India portfolio: 7 stocks rally up to 135% in CY26
simplifiedContent: The Government of Singapore has a portfolio of stocks in India, which means they have invested in various Indian companies. The total value of their investments decreased by 25% to Rs 1,51,353 crore in June 2026. However, some of the stocks they own, like Aditya Infotech, have done very well, with its value increasing by 137%. On the other hand, some of their other investments, such as HDFC Bank and Syngene International, have not performed as well, which brought down the overall value of their portfolio. This news matters because it shows how a major investor's portfolio is performing in the Indian stock market.

originalTitle: AU Small Finance Bank Q1 net profit jumps 37% to Rs 796 crore
simplifiedContent: AU Small Finance Bank just reported that its profit for the first quarter (Q1) of the year is Rs 796 crore, which is 37% more than the same time last year. This increase in profit is mainly due to the bank giving out more loans and having fewer bad debts. The bank's bad debts, also known as Gross NPA, decreased to 2.1%, which is a good sign. The bank also earned more from interest on its loans, with its net interest income growing 32% to Rs 2,695 crore. This news matters because it shows that the bank is performing well, which can be a positive sign for investors.

originalTitle: NTPC board approves raising up to Rs 12,000 cr via NCD issue
simplifiedContent: NTPC, a power generation company, has decided to borrow up to Rs 12,000 crore by issuing special kinds of bonds called non-convertible debentures. The company's total power generation capacity has grown to 90,904 MW, which is a measure of how much power it can produce. In the recent quarter, NTPC generated a lot of power, 93.63 billion units, and its coal-based plants were running at a high efficiency rate of 76.71%. The price at which it sold power remained steady at Rs 4.86 per unit. This news matters because it shows that NTPC is planning to raise a large amount of money, possibly to fund its growing power generation business.

originalTitle: AU Small Finance Bank Q1 results 2026: Net profit grows 37% to  ₹796 crore, NII up 32%
simplifiedContent: AU Small Finance Bank just released its quarterly results, and its profit increased by 37% to ₹796 crore compared to the same time last year. This growth was mainly due to an increase in the interest it earned from loans, which went up by 32%. The bank's performance was strong, even though it had a small increase in bad loans. This matters because it shows that the bank is doing well and making more money, which can be good for investors. The bank's strong results suggest that it is managing its operations effectively, despite some minor issues with bad loans.

originalTitle: Ashish Kacholia raises stake in this multibagger stock after 200% rally. Do you own?
simplifiedContent: Ashish Kacholia, a well-known investor, has increased his ownership in a company called Indo SMC. This company makes electrical parts and enclosures, and its sales have grown by 136% compared to the same time last year, reaching ₹88.12 crore. The company's stock price has already gone up by 200%, but Kacholia still decided to buy more shares, increasing his stake from 2.46% to 3.03%. This matters because it shows that Kacholia still believes in the company's potential for growth, even after its big price increase. It may be worth considering for individual investors, as it suggests that the company has a promising future.

originalTitle: Bharti Airtel Q1 Results 2026 Date: Telecom major to announce June quarter earnings on THIS date | Check details
simplifiedContent: Bharti Airtel, a major telecom company, will release its financial results for the quarter ending June 2026 on August 4. This report will show how the company performed in terms of how much money it made and how many new subscribers it gained. It will also include information on ARPU, which is a measure of how much money the company makes from each subscriber. The company has also announced that its employees and directors cannot buy or sell the company's stocks from July 1 to August 6, to ensure fairness. This announcement is important because it gives investors a chance to see how the company is doing and make informed decisions about their investments.
